scope: Strict same-App file exchange requirements and platform facts. Current implementation and acceptance are recorded in docs/CURRENT_STAGE.md; historical source-bound qualification does not qualify the current Memoh client.
platform_fact: Official API26 select-user-file guide explicitly supports Phone DocumentSelectMode.FOLDER from26.0.0. MIXED and authMode retain other device restrictions; old Phone unsupported claims do not apply wholesale
data_cost_boundary: Dedicated DOWNLOAD exchange directory is system-visible and writable by normal file operations; not a private vault. Only exchange content goes there; credentials, ledgers, drafts, caches remain private. Existing owned roots/originals and old receipts/leases remain protected. New final target is visible while incomplete; exclusive create never overwrites an existing filename, and uncertain ownership never authorizes deletion.

requirements.selection: Use the exact system-returned directory grant and stable root identity. No guessed parent path, fabricated document URI or arbitrary Web-provided filesystem path.
requirements.source: Read only authorized regular local children through a pinned root and opened descriptor. Recheck named/opened identity and source metadata across asynchronous copying; propagate provider and permission failures.
requirements.background: Background and cross-process transfers, process-death recovery and reopening remain required. A foreground-only upload/download is not a replacement or completed qualification.
requirements.destination: Exclusive creation must not overwrite an existing file. Persist creating intent and exact target identity before continuing; an uncertain create does not authorize adopting or deleting an existing target.
requirements.resume: Resume only the same owned root and target after identity, size and prefix validation. Full original size/SHA, current authorization, durable completion receipt and active-lease checks precede exact cache retirement.
requirements.protection: Preserve originals, drafts, existing grants, unknown or in-flight outcomes and valid leases. User-visible partial output is not an atomic completion claim.
requirements.stop_cancel: Stopping discovery, system work or a process does not prove cancellation or completion. Reopening must reconcile the same existing identity without duplicating an unknown operation.
requirements.album_boundary: File exchange is distinct from corresponding phone/NAS album convergence; paired album requirements remain in contracts/album_sync.json.
